metadata.title: [CHORE]: Update nav for the new React Admin UI
metadata.author: a-effort

description:
### 🔧 Chore Summary

Two nav updates for the new React Admin UI under epic #4093:  

[Design ](https://www.figma.com/design/H2Dr9QPvRVxCe92V8URvGT/Refiring?m=auto&node-id=2752-3874&t=4dhMJrfiiuGienJs-1)                                                                                      
   
  1. Remove the Metrics page from primary nav. Replace it with a link(s) from the Home screen to a dedicated observability tool(s) such as Phoenix/Langfuse, since those provide a deeper, better-maintained metrics experience than we can reasonably build in-app.                                                                      
  2. Swap the Prompts nav icon to Lucide [message-square-code  ](https://www.figma.com/design/lkYYvYbhpKEiPVcXV1YEDr/Lucide-Icons?node-id=5-7045&t=1iOv26eEr8L6AOJv-1) so its visual weight matches the surrounding nav icons.
                                                                                                                                                           
 Open for discussion: a small set of glanceable metrics may still belong on the home/landing screen.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
---

### 🧱 Area Affected

  - GitHub Actions / CI Pipelines
  - Pre-commit hooks / linters
  - Formatting (black, isort, ruff, etc.)                                                                                                                  
  - Type-checking (mypy, pyright, pytype, etc.)
  - Dependency cleanup or updates                                                                                                                          
  - Build system or Makefile                                                                                                                               
  - Containerization (Docker/Podman)
  - Docs or spellcheck                                                                                                                                     
  - SBOM, CVE scans, licenses, or security checks                                                                                                        
  - Other: New React Admin UI — primary navigation, information architecture, and iconography  

---

### ⚙️ Context / Rationale

Metrics page removal: 
ContextForge's current Metrics view duplicates a small slice of what mature observability platforms (Phoenix, Langfuse, Grafana, etc.) already do well. Maintaining a parallel in-app dashboard during the React rewrite (#4093) costs design and engineering time that's better spent on the Core Flows the epic prioritizes (server/virtual server/A2A management). Linking out to recommended third-party tools sets clearer expectations, reduces surface area, and lets us recommend the right tool for the depth of analysis users actually need. We can keep a few high-signal numbers visible on the home screen (e.g. recent activity, server health counts) without committing to a full dashboard.                                                   

Prompts icon swap; 
The current Prompts icon visually mismatches surrounding nav icons in stroke weight, which makes the nav feel uneven. Lucide icon `message-square-code` matches the weight of the rest of the set for better visual consistency.
                                                                                                                                                           
---

### 📦 Related Make Targets

  (New React UI work; tooling primarily lives under npm/Vite rather than the legacy Make targets.)
                                                                                                                                                           
  - make lint — backend lint pass if any route/redirect cleanup is needed                                                                                  
  - make pre-commit — pre-configured hooks                                                                                                                 
  - npm run dev / npm run test (new React UI) — local dev and Vitest verification 

---

### 📋 Acceptance Criteria

  Metrics removal:
  - Metrics entry removed from the primary nav in the new React UI                                                                                         
  - Any direct route to the old Metrics page either redirects to home or returns a clear "moved" state with link-outs                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  - No dead imports, dead routes, or orphaned components left behind from the removed page                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                         
  Prompts icon:                                                                                                                                            
  - Prompts nav item uses Lucide `message-square-code`                                                                                                      
  - Icon renders correctly in both light and dark mode at the nav's icon size                                                                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                                                           
  General:                                                                                                                                                 
  - Strings updated through FormatJS (no hardcoded English in the touched components)                                                                      
  - Vitest + React Testing Library coverage updated for the nav component (Metrics absent, link-outs render, Prompts icon present)                         
  - Linter and type-check pass cleanly                                                                                                                   
  - CI passes with no regressions                                                                                                                          
  - If user-facing docs reference the Metrics page, they're updated to point at the new link-outs

---

### 🧩 Additional Context

 - Parent epic: #4093                                                                                                                                                                                           
  - Open question — link-out destinations. Confirm the curated list of recommended observability tools. @jonpspri                      
  - Open question — glanceable home metrics. Decide in-scope vs. follow-up. Recommendation: ship the removal + link-outs in this issue and split the home-screen widgets into a separate sub-issue so this one stays small and reversible.                                                                    
  - Open question — backend impact. Confirm whether removing the Metrics UI lets us deprecate any backend endpoints, or whether they remain because external tools/scripts depend on them. Default assumption: backend endpoints stay, only the UI page is removed.
